definitions.gloss: loss, forfeiture (of reputation, authority, prestige, trust)
definitions.explanation: The loss or ruin of something intangible and valuable such as reputation, credibility, authority, or honor. Almost always used with abstract qualities, not physical objects.

examples.japanese: ⟦{信頼|しんらい}→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{失墜|しっつい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧スキャンダル⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{権威|けんい}→権威：13173_keni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{完全|かんぜん}→完全：01552_kanzen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{失墜|しっつい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: That scandal completely destroyed his authority.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不正|ふせい}→不正：01660_fusei⟧⟦{会計|かいけい}→会計：02536_kaikei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発覚|はっかく}→発覚：07629_hakkaku⟧し、⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ブランド→ブランド：05221_burando⟧⟦イメージ→イメージ：03832_imeeji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧{失墜|しっつい}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{株価|かぶか}→株価：05154_kabuka⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{急落|きゅうらく}→急落：09399_kyuuraku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Fraudulent accounting was exposed, the company's brand image was severely damaged, and stock prices also plummeted.

notes:
A compound of {失|しつ} (to lose) and {墜|つい} (to fall). The verb form is {失墜|しっつい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧. Carries a strong sense of falling from a high position — the {墜|つい} character is the same one used in ⟦{墜落|ついらく}→墜落：18763_tsuiraku⟧ (crash). Used almost exclusively with intangible qualities like reputation and trust, not with physical objects.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{信頼|しんらい}→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{失墜|しっつい}: loss of trust
- ⟦{権威|けんい}→権威：13173_keni⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{失墜|しっつい}: loss of authority
- ⟦{名誉|めいよ}→名誉：10568_meiyo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{失墜|しっつい}: loss of honor
- ⟦{威信|いしん}→威信：12259_ishin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{失墜|しっつい}⟦させる→する：00392_suru⟧: to damage one's prestige

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{喪失|そうしつ}→喪失：11836_soushitsu⟧: loss — more neutral and can apply to broader things (memory, motivation, etc.)
- ⟦{低下|ていか}→低下：04065_teika⟧: decline, decrease — gradual reduction, not the dramatic fall implied by {失墜|しっつい}
- ⟦{失|うしな}う→失う：01887_ushinau⟧: to lose — the basic verb for losing something
